preconditions.expression: all(2 <= int(line.split()[0]) < G for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+N])
preconditions.description: Every mutation rule's left-hand side (gene) is an integer between 2 and G-1 (inclusive).
Each mutation rule's right-hand side (replacement sequence) has at least one gene.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(b) < G for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+N] for b in line.split()[2:])
preconditions.description: All genes in mutation rules' right-hand sides are valid (0 ≤ gene < G).

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= a < G for a in {int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:1+N]}) == set(range(2, G))
preconditions.description: Every gene from 2 to G-1 appears as a left-hand side in at least one mutation rule.
Each antibody's length is at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(c) <= 1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1+N:] for c in line.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: All genes in antibodies are either 0 or 1.

preconditions.expression: G > 2 and N >= G - 2 and M >= 0
preconditions.description: Input constraints: G > 2, N ≥ G - 2, M ≥ 0.

postconditions.expression: stdout.splitlines() == [answer_line for gene in range(2, G) for answer_line in [f'YES' if all_detectable(gene) else f'NO {min_undetectable_length(gene)}']]
postconditions.description: For each gene from 2 to G-1, output 'YES' if all possible viruses derived from it are detectable by the given antibodies, otherwise output 'NO' followed by the minimal length of an undetectable virus.

postconditions.expression: all('YES' in line or ('NO' in line and line.split()[1].isdigit()) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' or 'NO' followed by a valid integer (minimal length).
Exactly G-2 lines are output, one for each gene from 2 to G-1.
